name: Identity, Accounts, Organizations, and Device Trust
description: Local principal model, account identity provider abstraction, device identity and enrollment, device key rotation, user profile and handle model, organization and team hierarchy, membership lifecycle, role and group model, recovery credentials, multi-device session management, authentication event audit, offline identity cache, account export/deletion, organization transfer, suspicious login response, and federation identity binding.
objective: Build the identity layer: principals, accounts, organizations, device trust, and federation identity binding.
